info.name: ABC-3
info.description: Aye Bee See API. Run 'Users > Login' first: its test script stores the token in the {{jwt}} collection variable, which every other request sends as a bearer token. Registration and login are the only public requests. Ids in bodies are examples from the seed data; seeded ids are not guaranteed, so read them from list responses.

request.description: Deletes the account and every letter, reply, attachment and thread of the person. Your own account needs `password`; an admin deleting someone else, or a group deleting its unclaimed writer, does not. Cannot be undone.
